label: KNIKERS' schedule
text: They have 6 open slots on Tuesday and Thursday, so expect streamers there. They're heavy on Wednesday, Friday and Saturday (8–9 players).

label: Their roster
text: Flagg, Towns, Mikal Bridges, Anunoby, Fox and Alexander-Walker: strong in steals and FT%, weak in assists and FG%. Tobias Harris is out.

label: Saturday gap
text: KNIKERS have 8 players on Saturday; Mobley-Wan has 3. That one day is worth about 5 more games to them.

label: Saturday
text: Fill the 7 open Saturday slots with streamers on Friday night; it closes most of their edge.

label: Points
text: Points (37%) is the cheapest category to flip: extra games on Thursday and Saturday add points without hurting FG%.

label: Ignore
text: Don't chase steals (5%) or FT% (34%); the build punts both.
